description: Declared platform matrix for the self-contained sap-adt runtime. 'status' is maintained explicitly: 'verified-local' and 'verified-ci' require a real native build + install smoke on that OS/arch, locally or in CI respectively. Never mark a target verified from a script's existence alone.

windows-x86_64.notes: CLI 1.6.7 Windows x64 runtime built with Windows Python 3.12 via WSL interop on 2026-11-27/28 UTC. Targeted Python regressions: 66 passed; Windows-local npm regressions: 43 passed, 6 platform-specific skips. Both built Python entries and isolated native npm entries passed installation, version/ownership and uninstall coexistence checks; diagnostic/debugger/execution cross-process smokes passed with generic source writes disabled. The desktop installer was built with verified official portable Inno Setup 6.7.4 and passed native PATH cleanup tests, silent per-user install in a Unicode/space path, same-version upgrade and uninstall; synthetic configuration and user PATH were preserved. Interactive wizard, actual PATH mutation, elevated installation, live Windows SAP access and live debugger attachment are unverified.

linux-x86_64.notes: CLI 1.6.7 verified on Ubuntu 24.04 glibc 2.39 (WSL2), 2026-11-27/28 UTC: 622 Python and 49 npm tests passed. Built-wheel and native npm checks passed for both entries, update ownership, configuration hints and uninstall coexistence; diagnostic/debugger/execution cross-process smokes keep generic source writes disabled. Clean public PyPI and npm installs, dependency resolution, real GitHub runtime downloads and update checks passed after publication. This branding release did not connect to SAP; see executor.md and core-workflows.md for historical DEV acceptance and evidence limits. Coverage and abaplint use supplied bound reports, not attested native instrumentation. glibc floor applies to other distros; do not generalize to musl/older glibc without a real build there. Live debugger attachment is unverified.

darwin-aarch64.notes: Experimental CLI 1.6.7 macOS 15+ Apple Silicon runtime, verified 2026-11-27/28 UTC. Native macos-15 CI with Python 3.14 ran 622 Python tests (3 skips) and 49 npm tests (48 passed, 1 skip), passed both Python wheel checks, runtime build and isolated dual-entry npm diagnostic/debugger/execution cross-process smokes and uninstall coexistence: Actions run 46085176822, source 2fe398e9e4c1e178993e68841ac2862218881a33. Execution smokes keep generic source writes disabled. No personal Mac, older macOS, live SAP, Keychain, Gatekeeper/quarantine, signing or notarization verification.
